submission_requirements.description: Character Director must complete all corrective tasks and submit conclusions in a controlled, auditable format before retry authorization

checkpoint_suitability_assessment.description: Assessment of current checkpoint (realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors) suitability for target character type

required_content.character_type_match_score: number 0-100 - how well checkpoint renders specified character type
required_content.visual_quality_benchmark: string - expected visual quality level with this checkpoint
required_content.identity_stability_assessment: string - assessment of identity consistency capability

alternative_checkpoint_recommendation.description: If current checkpoint deemed inadequate, specify alternative checkpoint recommendation

required_content.recommended_checkpoint_path: string - path or identifier for checkpoint location
required_content.character_compatibility_rationale: string - why this checkpoint better supports character type
required_content.expected_visual_quality: string - expected quality level with recommended checkpoint
required_content.workflow_compatibility_notes: string - notes for Workflow TD evaluation

character_identity_guidance_revision.description: Revised character identity guidance and specification compatible with selected checkpoint

required_content.original_guidance_reference: string - path to original character specification
required_content.revised_positive_prompt_guidance: string - updated positive prompt guidance for character
required_content.revised_negative_prompt_guidance: string - updated negative prompt guidance for character

consistency_targets.facial_features: string - target consistency level for facial features
consistency_targets.body_proportions: string - target consistency level for body proportions
consistency_targets.clothing_style: string - target consistency level for clothing/style
consistency_targets.overall_appearance: string - target consistency level for overall character appearance

required_content.checkpoint_specific_considerations: string - any checkpoint-specific character rendering considerations

reference_identity_preservation_requirem.description: Reference image and identity preservation requirements for retry

required_content.existing_reference_valid: boolean - whether existing reference images remain valid
required_content.existing_reference_path: string - path to current reference image(s)
required_content.updated_reference_required: boolean - whether new reference images needed
required_content.updated_reference_path: string - path to updated reference image(s) if applicable
required_content.reference_compatibility_notes: string - notes on reference compatibility with revised specification
required_content.identity_strength_requirements: string - required identity preservation strength level
required_content.reference_weighting_recommendation: string - recommended reference weighting if applicable

retry_readiness_verdict.description: Explicit ready/not-ready verdict for retry planning from Character Director perspective

required_content.verdict_rationale: string - detailed rationale for readiness verdict
blocking_issues: string - list of any blocking issues preventing ready status
conditions_for_readiness: string - conditions that must be met if verdict is ready_with_conditions
required_content.confidence_level: enum: [high, medium, low] - confidence in retry success with current recommendations

joint_gate_dependency.description: Character Director completion must be submitted and validated before joint gate can clear. Both Character Director and Workflow TD completions required.
joint_gate_dependency.retry_authorized_by: joint validation of both role completion contracts
